new file mode 100644
index 00000000..e7109d2e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro.py
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+
+import asyncio
+from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter
+from starlette.testclient import TestClient
+
+async def test_startup_shutdown():
+    startup_called = False
+    shutdown_called = False
+
+    async def startup():
+        nonlocal startup_called
+        startup_called = True
+        print("Startup called!")
+
+    async def shutdown():
+        nonlocal shutdown_called
+        shutdown_called = True
+        print("Shutdown called!")
+
+    # Test APIRouter
+    router = APIRouter(on_startup=[startup], on_shutdown=[shutdown])
+    app = FastAPI()
+    app.include_router(router)
+
+    print("Starting app with TestClient...")
+    with TestClient(app) as client:
+        print("App started")
+        assert startup_called, "Startup handler was not called!"
+        print("Startup handler was called!")
+
+    print("App stopped")
+    assert shutdown_called, "Shutdown handler was not called!"
+    print("Shutdown handler was called!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        asyncio.run(test_startup_shutdown())
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
